entry.title: New: Bill 212 (2022-2024) (Hawaiʻi County) — Adopted
entry.content:
AMENDS CHAPTER 5, ARTICLE 3, DIVISION 2, SECTION 5-3-22, OF THE HAWAIʻI COUNTY CODE 1983 (2016 EDITION, AS AMENDED), RELATING TO BUILDING PERMIT EXEMPTIONS

Exempts greenhouses and other accessory structures with a floor area of 1,000 sq. ft. or less and located on agriculturally-zoned land from the requirement to obtain a building permit

Latest action: Council: Bill 212 passes second & final reading - 11/8/2024
